title: COMPOT: Calibration-Optimized Matrix Procrustes Orthogonalization for Transformers Compression
abstract: arXiv:2602.15200v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Post-training compression of transformer models commonly relies on truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) strategies leading to low-rank approximations of the original model weights. However, the underlying single shared subspace modeling can degrade accuracy even at moderate compression. Sparse dictionary learning provides a more flexible union-of-subspaces representation, but existing approaches often suffer from costly iterative dictionary and coefficient updates. We propose $\textbf{COMPOT}$ ($\textbf{C}$alibration-$\textbf{O}$ptimized $\textbf{M}$atrix $\textbf{P}$rocrustes $\textbf{O}$rthogonalization for $\textbf{T}$ransformers), a training-free compression framework that uses a small calibration dataset to estimate a sparse weight factorization. COMPOT employs orthogonal dictionaries that enable closed-form Procrustes updates for the dictionary and analytical single-step sparse coding for the coefficients, reducing sign

translated_title: COMPOT：面向Transformer压缩的校准优化矩阵Procrustes正交化
translated_abstract: Transformer模型的后训练压缩通常依赖于截断奇异值分解（SVD）策略，从而得到原始模型权重的低秩近似。然而，其底层的单一共享子空间建模即使在中等压缩率下也可能导致精度下降。稀疏字典学习提供了更灵活的子空间并集表示，但现有方法往往存在代价高昂的迭代字典和系数更新问题。我们提出了COMPOT（面向Transformer的校准优化矩阵Procrustes正交化），这是一个免训练的压缩框架，它使用小型校准数据集来估计稀疏权重分解。COMPOT采用正交字典，可实现字典的闭式Procrustes更新和系数的解析式单步稀疏编码，从而减少符号（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: COMPOT是一种免训练的Transformer压缩框架，利用小型校准数据集进行稀疏权重分解，通过正交字典实现闭式Procrustes字典更新和解析式单步稀疏编码，克服了传统SVD低秩近似精度不足和稀疏字典学习迭代开销大的问题。
